translations.en: In exchange for the jewelry box,
@7rLady Marbas@0r says she'll tell you something useful.
The jewelry box is somewhere on the upper levels of @6rGraham Rootze@0r.
Well, good luck.
I've passed on the request, so it's up to you now!
Well, if that's what you want, fine...
When I saw @7rLady Marbas@0r outside the city,
she looked pretty serious.
A request has come in for you.
They asked for you by name,
so I volunteered to pass it on.
The client is @7rLady Marbas@0r.
She wants you to find something. Will you do it?
@7rCarmine@0r watches you with interest.
A request from @7rLady Marbas@0r...
What should you do?
I wish I had something that could save the world,
but I'm sorry. I have nothing of the sort right now.
So in the end, all I can offer you
as a reward is money.
I'm sorry.
As a reward, @7rBeatrix@0r gave you @3r50,000 G@0r.
For now, since we have this opportunity,
I'll investigate the @3rFrog Statue@0r further.
The new seal can only be activated after the current one breaks.
That fact must have disappointed @7rBeatrix@0r.
@7rBeatrix@0r can only sigh weakly.
But this is reality.
Whatever the circumstances,
you cannot allow yourselves to stop moving forward.
I'm sorry. Looking so defeated isn't like me.
As long as we're alive, we must resist with all our might.
A smile has returned to her lips.
She will be all right now.
Somehow, seeing that smile is enough to reassure you.
Now, once you're ready, go to @6rGraham Rootze@0r
and find the shrine. I'm counting on you, as always.
Have you decided to take the job?
I'd really like you to accept...
First, let's go to @6rGraham Rootze@0r.
Legend says there's a shrine there from the distant past.
I don't know what sort of shrine it is,
but it might be small, so be careful not to overlook it.
I see. Well, it can't be helped.
Let me know if you change your mind.
I've deciphered the @3rBook of Keys@0r.
It seems this is the key to obtaining a @3rSpare Seal@0r.
Apparently, this key alone cannot do anything
to the ancient seal. And even using it
will take considerable effort.
The key bears this inscription in an ancient language:
"Use the key on the box made by light. Honor God and step back three paces."
translations.note: Functional riddle: box made by light, honoring God, and three backward paces must all remain. Requires testing against the actual puzzle interaction.

translations.en: It's probably a riddle.
The problem is, I don't know which god it means.
It isn't @7rAvrul the Creator@0r or @7rAz the Absolute God@0r...
For now, what I'd like you to do
is use this key to recover what we believe is the @3rSpare Seal@0r.
Will you take the job?
Looks like you've gathered everything.
Now, put it all into that vessel.
We won't be using fire or anything, so we can do it here.
Now, a quick question.
What kind of weapon do you want?
Sword
Staff
Blunt Weapon
Throwing Weapon
A @3rSword@0r. Got it, got it.
Now, I'll press this switch...
There. All done.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received @3rTyrfing@0r.
A @3rStaff@0r. Got it, got it.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received a @3rComet Staff@0r.
A @3rBlunt Weapon@0r. Got it, got it.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received the @3rFlame Emperor's Hammer@0r.
A @3rThrowing Weapon@0r. Got it, got it.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received a @3rSecret Weapon@0r.
Sorry if it isn't quite the weapon you wanted.
This is pretty improvised alchemy,
so I hope you'll cut me some slack.

context: Carmine requests a jewelry box; Beatrix explains the Spare Seal riddle; Carmine creates one of four weapon types.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
